subject: Anonymous Tip — Valcourt BioLabs
body:
Detective,

This tip was submitted anonymously via the CID public line.

---

"I work near the Valcourt building. On the night of the 28th, around 10 PM, I saw a black van parked in the restricted service lane. No plates. Two people in dark clothing went in through the side entrance. I didn't think much of it at the time but after reading the news this morning I thought you should know.

Please keep my name out of this."

---

This tip has been logged and forwarded to your case file. Treat as unverified until corroborated.

— CID Tip System
